Implemented [Dashboard](/workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx:1) as an async Server Component. It fetches analytics, notifications, and settings concurrently with `Promise.all`, displays each JSON response in its own section, and shows an error message if a request fails.

TypeScript and the production build pass. This repo has no `/api/analytics`, `/api/notifications`, or `/api/settings` implementations, so live data display could not be verified.
